about: Senior system administrator with nearly a decade of hands-on experience keeping mixed on-premise and cloud environments stable, secure, and audited. I enjoy untangling brittle legacy infrastructure and replacing it with documented, automated, repeatable processes that the whole team can trust.

experiences.description: Owned the operational health of a multi-site server estate, leading patch cycles, backup verification, and incident response for business-critical services. Mentored two junior administrators and introduced a change-control process that sharply reduced unplanned outages.

Maintained virtualization hosts and storage clusters for a managed-hosting customer base, handling capacity planning and after-hours escalations. Automated routine provisioning so that new customer environments could be stood up in hours rather than days.

Administered directory services, mail, and file infrastructure for an organization of several hundred users. Drove a migration off aging hardware while keeping downtime within tight maintenance windows.

Supported daily operations of a regional data center, monitoring systems and responding to first-line infrastructure tickets. Documented recurring fixes into a shared knowledge base that became the team's go-to reference.
